title: Workflow and Human Factors
summary: Workflow analysis, usability heuristics, the Sittig-Singh sociotechnical model, and why the same EHR build fails one clinic and succeeds in another. The module that explains everything the previous modules can't.
learningOutcomes: Map a clinical workflow using a recognized notation and identify rework loops.
Apply Nielsen's heuristics and the SAFER guides to a given EHR screen.
Name the eight dimensions of the Sittig-Singh sociotechnical model and use them to diagnose a real failure.
Distinguish workflow problems from training problems from configuration problems.
Explain why a usability complaint is almost never just a usability complaint.
